name: com.achirastudio.fsr4
description: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR 4 ML / FSR 3.1 fallback) as a custom upscaler for URP on the Unity Upscaler Framework, with an optional experimental frame-generation module. Direct3D12 and Vulkan. Built on FidelityFX SDK 2.4.0.

samples.description: Minimal IMGUI toggle that switches frame generation from your own code.
